visible_setting: A narrow aisle inside one small room at rainy dusk; a table, glowing lamp, charger and water glass are visible.

hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand contacts the phone; her left hand is pocketed. The man's left hand contacts the glass; his right hand is hidden behind his body. Their bodies do not touch.
gaze: Neither looks at the other; both faces turn away with tightened brows and mouths.
body_blocking: They occupy the same narrow aisle at the same depth with torsos angled in opposite directions.

body_blocking: Tight side profile; no other person, mirror or reflection is visible.

hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand holds the wardrobe handle; her left arm is behind the door. The man's right hand rests on the chair back; his left hand rests on his thigh.
gaze: They look across the narrow remaining gap at each other.
body_blocking: The wardrobe door and chair occupy opposite diagonals and block the only path between the two people.
object_state: Wardrobe is open; chair is rolled back; lamp remains upright and lit; extension cord remains slack; an untouched meal sits on the table.
camera_view: Extreme overhead wide view from the ceiling corner.
visible_continuity: Same room, clothes, lamp, charger, bags, umbrella and meal.

visible_setting: Low table-level view in the same room; an extension board fills the lower foreground.
observable_action: The woman and man each drag one opposite plastic end of the same live extension board toward themselves at the same moment. The board rotates and skids diagonally, its taut black lamp cord lifts the intact lamp base mid-tip, and the moving board clips the key bowl so two keys spill along the impact direction.
hands_and_contact: The woman's left shoulder, arm, wrist and hand connect to and grip only the board's left plastic end. The man's right shoulder, arm, wrist and hand connect to and grip only the board's right plastic end. Their other hands are outside the frame; neither visible hand holds a plug.
gaze: Both faces recoil toward the sliding board and tipping lamp; mouths are closed.
body_blocking: They lean in from opposite sides without crossing bodies or touching.
object_state: A white charger adapter and black lamp plug remain inserted in occupied sockets; both cables are taut in opposite directions; the board skids and rotates; the intact lamp lifts mid-tip; the struck bowl releases two keys; nothing breaks.
camera_view: Low obstructed close view with foreground consequence and faces behind.
visible_continuity: Same charcoal clothing, chair, untouched meal, lamp and extension board.

visible_setting: The same room in cool rainy near-darkness at floor height; the intact lamp rests on its side beside the extension board.
observable_action: The man lifts the lamp by its base while the woman pushes the lamp plug into the extension board. Warm light returns between them.
hands_and_contact: The man's right hand owns the lamp base and his left hand rests on his thigh. The woman's left hand owns the plug and her right hand braces on the floor beside her knee. All four wrists and forearms remain visible.
gaze: Both keep set jaws and meet eyes only as the lamp lights.
body_blocking: They kneel at the same depth on opposite sides of the lamp with separate silhouettes.
object_state: Lamp changes from dark and sideways to supported and lit; plug becomes connected; cord becomes slack.
camera_view: Intimate floor-height three-quarter close insert with hands sharp and faces readable.
visible_continuity: Same creased charcoal-and-ivory wardrobe; no object is broken.

visible_setting: The same room seen from farther outside the doorway; rain remains at the window and the chair is still displaced.
observable_action: The woman and man sit shoulder-to-shoulder on the floor inside the lamp's warm pool. The woman offers the final piece of food and the man receives it.
hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand offers the food and her left hand rests on her knee. The man's left hand receives and his right hand rests on his own knee.
gaze: They meet eyes with tired neutral expressions rather than broad smiles.
body_blocking: They sit at the same depth with shoulders lightly touching and no embrace.
object_state: Lamp is upright and lit; extension cord is slack; wardrobe is closed; key bowl is settled; the previously untouched meal is nearly finished.
camera_view: Stable wide doorway reprise pulled farther back than the first frame.
